'''Clingmoss''' was a [[Parasite/Legends|parasitic]] [[Moss/Legends|moss]] that clung to creatures such as [[Rancor/Legends|rancors]]. [[Lucky (rancor)|Lucky]] was known to harbor clingmosses. Clingmosses were retrieved as an ingredient during the [[Feast of Prosperity/Legends|Feast of Prosperity]] on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]].<ref name="Belsavis" />
